","imageSide":"left"|"right"} one screenshot next to a short text. {"type":"features","items":[{"title":"..","text":".."}]} a feature list: 1 to 6 points, title up to 80 and text up to 300 characters, plain text. {"type":"image","mediaIds":[ids],"view":..,"aspect":..,"fit":..} up to 12 screenshots; view plain, slides, carousel, laptop, iphone, android or tablet; aspect 16:9 (default), 16:10, 4:3, 1:1, 4:5 or 9:16 for plain, slides and carousel; fit cover (fills, may crop) or contain (whole image). {"type":"clip","mediaId":id,"view":..,"playback":"autoplay"|"click"} your preview clip, at most once; view plain, laptop, iphone, android or tablet; autoplay plays muted when it scrolls into view, click shows a play button. The clip always plays in the media stage at the top of the page; a clip block shows it again at its place. {"type":"video","youtubeId":"","view":..} a YouTube video, loaded only after a click. Media ids come from get_product_page; unknown ids are refused and nothing is saved. Every screenshot shows in the media stage at the top of the page, with or without a block. At most 40 blocks. On a software that is already on sale, changed text (text, mediaText and features blocks) gets a quick automatic text check: it goes live at once, or the response has text_check with outcome "rejected" and a reason, and the current page stays. If the check is unavailable, the text waits (the response has changes_pending_review) and is checked again automatically. Images, clip, video and layout go live at once. Read get_product_page afterwards: warnings should be empty. Requires sign-in to your Crela account; your client asks you to connect when you first use it.
